title: Summer Bootcamp Blitz — Youth Skills Training Campaign
objective: Drive enrollment into July–August bootcamps (coding, design, English) by positioning them as summer essentials for school holidays; target cost-per-enrollment of MMK 8,000–12,000.
target_audience: Students aged 14–22, parents in Yangon & Mandalay seeking holiday upskilling
key_activities: TikTok & Instagram Reels campaign (12 videos) showing bootcamp day-in-the-life moments
Student testimonial UGC seeding across 6–8 micro-influencers (10k–50k followers)
Meta/TikTok paid ads targeting school holiday intent (keyword-adjacent audiences)
WhatsApp + SMS enrollment funnel with live chat support
Weekly performance dashboard (enrollments, cost-per-lead, CAC)
kpis: 120–180 course enrollments within 4 weeks
Cost-per-enrollment ≤ MMK 10,500
12–16% click-through rate (CTR) on paid ads
8–10 pieces of UGC posted by student influencers
why_now: July school holidays in Myanmar drive peak demand for skill-building courses; TikTok/Instagram engagement peaks as youth consume content during break; influencer season coincides with summer camps.
deliverables: 12 short-form videos (15–60s) showcasing bootcamp curriculum & student success stories
6–8 influencer partnership packages (2–3 videos per creator, UGC rights)
Meta & TikTok ad creative (3 variants: emotional, rational, disruptive)
SMS/WhatsApp enrollment funnel template + daily chat support brief
Weekly performance report (enrollments, CAC, ROAS, CTR)

title: Schools Reimagined — Educational Institution Launch Event
objective: Host a 200-guest premium launch for a new international school's opening in Yangon; position as the 'future of education' for affluent parents and education stakeholders; generate 50+ qualified leads & media coverage.
target_audience: Affluent parents (ages 35–55), education officers, international school administrators, local media & KOLs
key_activities: Invitation-only evening gala (200 pax) with campus showcase & interactive learning zones
Cinematic brand film reveal (3–4 min, led by ZYNTH production) played on LED wall
Live panel: international educators + Yangon education leaders discussing future of learning
QR-based lead capture at each zone (parent enquiry qualification)
Press kit & KOL briefing; 5–8 tier-1 media placements
Same-night social content push (10–15 posts across Instagram/Facebook)
kpis: 200 confirmed attendees (RSVPs tracked via QR + manual list)
50+ qualified parent leads captured (each tagged by interest: primary/secondary/international)
1.2M+ earned social media impressions (organic + PR amplification)
5–8 tier-1 media placements (news features, education section coverage)
3–5 follow-up enquiries per qualified lead within 14 days post-event
why_now: July falls during school holiday break; parents actively explore new schools for upcoming academic year (August–September intake); international school calendars align with mid-year enrolment decisions.
deliverables: Full run-of-show for 200-pax gala event (venue, catering, AV, stage, décor budget detailed)
1 cinematic brand film (3–4 min, ZYNTH concept/script/direction, production outsourced)
Interactive zone design + signage (3 learning zone concepts: STEM, Language, Global Citizenship)
Press kit (2-page school story, 3 founder quotes, 5 high-res photos from event preview)
QR lead-capture system + follow-up email sequence (5 emails over 14 days)
Event-night social content (15 Instagram posts + 5 Facebook albums, scheduled over 48 hours)

title: Code Camp Chronicles — Coding Bootcamp Brand Activation
objective: Activate a coding bootcamp across 3 Yangon townships with pop-up demo zones; attract 300+ trial signups, build brand awareness among target students, generate 25+ social-ready moments.
target_audience: Students aged 16–25 interested in tech careers; parents seeking tech skills training; township communities in Yangon (Kamaryut, Thingangyun, Bahan)
key_activities: 3 pop-up demo stations (township malls: Kamaryut Central, Thingangyun Plaza, Bahan Junction) open 4 days each
Live coding challenges with prizes (laptops, course scholarships); 1-hour daily demos
20-second TikTok/Instagram Reels shot live at each station (local students showcasing projects)
Sampling: free 2-hour coding taster session for top 20 challengers per location
Influencer presence (4 tech micro-influencers, 15k–40k followers each; 1 per location + rotation)
Post-activation content series: 8 success stories from trial signups (reels + carousels)
kpis: 300+ trial signup registrations (tracked via unique QR codes per location)
25+ pieces of UGC/social-ready content generated from activations
4–6 influencer posts featuring activation (combined reach: 80k–150k)
15–20% conversion rate from trial signup to paid course enrollment within 4 weeks
1.5M+ organic social impressions from activation + UGC seeding
why_now: July is school holiday season; students have free time for coding challenges and taster sessions; township footfall peaks during mid-year holidays; influencer season peaks as creators pursue summer activations.
deliverables: 3 pop-up station designs (booth layout, interactive demo setup, branding signage, equipment list)
Pop-up run-of-show (4-day schedule per location: hours, staff roles, challenge flow, sampling logistics)
8 short-form social videos (15–30s Reels/TikToks from live activations)
4 influencer partnership briefs (appearance fee, content deliverables, posting schedule)
QR-based trial signup system + follow-up SMS sequence (3 messages: welcome, reminder, offer)
Post-activation content series: 8 Reels (student success stories from trial signups, 30–45s each)

title: Scholarship Stories — EdTech Lead Generation Digital Campaign
objective: Drive high-intent leads for online education platform's scholarship program; target cost-per-qualified-lead of MMK 6,500–8,500; build email list of 400+ interested students for nurture funnel.
target_audience: Students aged 18–28 seeking affordable upskilling (English, data analytics, digital marketing); Myanmar + Burmese diaspora; email + WhatsApp access
key_activities: 5-part email funnel (awareness → interest → application) with segmentation by skill interest
Google Search Ads targeting 'affordable online course Myanmar', 'scholarship Myanmar education'
Meta Lookalike audiences (seed: existing scholarship applicants + engaged social followers)
3 case-study landing pages (optimized for mobile): Student A (English scholar → job), B (Data analytics → promotion), C (Digital marketing → freelance income)
Conversion-optimized lead form (2-step: interest + email | 2nd step: details + scholarship eligibility quiz)
Weekly lead scoring dashboard (interest level, scholarship eligibility, CAC by channel)
kpis: 400+ qualified leads captured (email-verified, scholarship-eligible)
Cost-per-qualified-lead ≤ MMK 7,500
18–24% email open rate (industry benchmark: 14–18%)
8–12% conversion rate from landing page visit to lead form submission
3.5–4.5 return on ad spend (ROAS) on paid channels
why_now: July is school break; students research upskilling options during idle time; scholarship intake window aligns with August–September course start dates; email/search intent peaks during holiday break.
deliverables: 3 case-study landing pages (mobile-optimized, A/B test variant, testimonial video embeds)
5-email nurture sequence (day 1: welcome + intro offer | day 4: case study #1 | day 8: social proof | day 12: urgency | day 16: final offer)
Google Search Ads campaign (8 ad variants, 3 keyword groups, target CPC MMK 800–1,200)
Meta Lookalike Ad Campaign (3 creative variants: emotional, rational, disruptive; 2 audience segments)
Lead-scoring rubric & weekly dashboard (lead source, form-fill time, interest level, scholarship eligibility)
2-step lead form template (step 1: email + interest | step 2: name + phone + scholarship quiz)

title: Future-Ready: Education Rebranding Campaign
objective: Reposition a legacy training center as a modern, tech-forward educational brand; build awareness of new visual identity + value proposition across Yangon; target 800k+ reach, 6% engagement rate.
target_audience: Students aged 16–35; parents seeking quality training; employers in tech, finance, retail; education professionals & school administrators
key_activities: Brand reveal event (100 pax: staff, alumni, media, partner schools) with new logo/visual identity unveiling
Rebranding rollout content series (12 posts): heritage story → new vision → student success → course highlights
3 founder/director testimonial videos (30–60s each): 'Why we evolved' + 'What's next' narrative
Paid social amplification: new brand identity campaign (Meta/TikTok, 3-week flight)
Influencer storytelling: 4 education/career micro-influencers share their 'future-ready' skill journey (4 videos, 30–45s each)
Press outreach: 3–5 business/education media placements announcing rebrand + growth plans
kpis: 800k+ total organic + paid reach across all channels
6–8% engagement rate on rebrand content (industry benchmark: 2–4%)
3–5 tier-2 media placements (education, business, local news outlets)
25–35% increase in website traffic during campaign window (baseline tracked pre-launch)
200+ new social media followers from campaign (sustained 30 days post-launch)
why_now: July positioning allows rebrand to take hold before August–September new academic year intake; fresh-start narrative aligns with school holiday season; influencer engagement peaks in summer for education-focused stories.
deliverables: Rebranding event (100 pax, venue + catering + AV + staged brand reveal, run-of-show)
Brand reveal film (2–3 min; heritage + vision narrative, ZYNTH concept/script/direction)
12-post content calendar (visual identity rollout, heritage, new courses, student success stories)
3 founder/leader testimonial videos (30–60s each, ZYNTH production direction)
4 influencer partnership briefs (education/career micro-influencers, 1 video each, UGC rights)
Meta & TikTok Rebrand Campaign (3-week flight, 6 creative variants, lookalike + interest targeting)
Press kit + media outreach (2-page rebrand story, 5 high-res brand identity assets, 3 media pitches)
